content.text:
- Local:        http://localhost:3000
 ✓ Ready in 3s
=== final page checks ===
/ -> HTTP 200
/energie -> HTTP 200
/mobilitaet -> HTTP 500
/gebaeude -> HTTP 500
/klima -> HTTP 500

observation.command:
cd /workspace && nohup yarn dev > /tmp/dev-server-final.log 2>&1 & 
sleep 20; grep -E "Ready|Local" /tmp/dev-server-final.log; echo "=== final page checks ==="; for p in "" energie mobilitaet gebaeude klima; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 180 "http://localhost:3000/$p"); echo "/$p -> HTTP $code"; done
